annotations.title: Get a sevDesk bank transaction with its assignments

description: Show one bank transaction (Kontoumsatz) with its assignments (Zuordnungen): which invoices (Rechnungen), credit notes (Gutschriften) or vouchers (Belege) it was booked to, with how much, and the amount still unassigned (exact; from sevDesk's booking log). Use it before sevdesk_transaction_book (partly linked transactions, status 200, can be booked up to the remaining amount) and before sevdesk_transaction_reset (to see what would be undone). Find ids with sevdesk_transactions_list. Offline and cash accounts get their transactions from payment bookings, so they are booked already. Read-only.
name: sevdesk_transaction_get
title: Get a sevDesk bank transaction with its assignments
